# Pragma Research

Pragma Research is a mathematics frontier research company with two focus areas: fundamental physics and machine learning. Both programs build on one mathematical idea. Many bounded parts, each with a partial view, reach a shared state by comparing overlapping views and repairing disagreement.

## Fundamental physics: Observer Patch Holography (OPH)

OPH is a research program for a unified theory of quantum mechanics and gravity. It starts from bounded observers that keep local records, compare overlapping views and repair disagreement. The papers classify results separately as exact finite theorems, results conditional on named premises, and comparisons with measurement.

- Program overview: https://floatingpragma.io/physics/
- Preprint (PhilPapers): https://philpapers.org/rec/MUEFOC
- Research site: https://floatingpragma.io/oph/
- Paper index with HTML and PDF editions: https://floatingpragma.io/oph/papers/
- Machine-readable paper inventory: https://floatingpragma.io/oph/papers/papers.json
- Paper LLM index: https://floatingpragma.io/oph/papers/llms.txt
- Textbooks and guided learning: https://learn.floatingpragma.io/
- Book for general readers: https://oph-book.floatingpragma.io/
- Collaborative source repository: https://github.com/FloatingPragma/observer-patch-holography/
- Interactive lab: https://oph-lab.floatingpragma.io/
- Mini-universe simulation: https://simulation.floatingpragma.io/

## Machine learning: Cadence

Cadence is an open-source (MIT) Python library for patch nets. Every unit repairs its own state from its neighbours until the network settles, and the rest state is the answer. Learning is the same settlement nudged toward a target, followed by a strictly local update in the equilibrium-propagation family. There is no backward pass.

- Program overview: https://floatingpragma.io/cadence/
- Library: https://github.com/muellerberndt/cadence
- Examples ladder: https://github.com/muellerberndt/cadence-examples
- Package: https://pypi.org/project/cadence-net/ (pip install cadence-net)
